infobox.effect: Buffs:, 1s Delay; 600s Duration: - Increases Perception (+30) - Lowers body temperature (-4 °C) - Increases energy recovery (+0.05/s) - Increases hydration recovery (+0.05/s) Debuffs:, 606s Delay; 300s Duration: - Raises body temperature (+6 °C)

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: Using this stimulant will lower the body Temperature by 4 °C, making the user harder to be seen by thermal scopes and the T-7 thermal goggles.

sections.heading: The Lab
sections.text:
- Laboratory experiment's area (G12) on the first level (Requires TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black))
- Sanitar's room in the Laboratory block (G22) on the second level (Requires Keycard with a blue marking)
- On the floor of the "Med Hut" on the main floor, first Level (O11)
- On the left hand table in the Laboratory quarantine zone (G11) (Requires TerraGroup Labs keycard (Blue))
- In the laboratories inside the containment block

sections.heading: Quest rewards
sections.text: - 2 can be obtained as a quest reward from This Tape Sucks

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: - Easter eggs and References: The QR code on the label reads "средство для разогрева ягодиц 3000", which translates to "buttocks warming agent 3000".
